utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s getting a decent turnout today—sounds like folks are really showing up. I’m running errands now, but I’ll swing by if I finish in time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Ira—no rush at all. We’re here all afternoon, so come by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll try to make it over after I finish these errands. Hope the drive keeps going strong until then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll sort my things by 10, then head over with the first load. If you want, I can check the list with you before we go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Eli—let’s check the list first and make sure we’ve got everything before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll bring my list, and we can go through it together now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the quickest way I can help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you can, grab a box of gloves and some basic tools first—those always go fast. Then I’ll point you to the next gap we need to fill.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll grab gloves and a few basic tools first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring your toolbox and help fix a couple loose fence boards?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring my toolbox and help with the fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today. I’m heading over in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and where everyone’s going to park, but I can help if we keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, let’s keep it organized — I’ll repeat the plan to everyone and help sort out the parking.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that would really help. If you can keep folks informed, I’ll make sure we’ve got a clear parking setup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help out; just remind me what’s still needed and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren—mostly we still need tools, some spare parts, and a way to sort everything before Saturday. I’m trying to keep the list organized so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—tools, spare parts, and sorting help. I’ll check what I have and bring anything useful before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got on hand for the repair drive and note anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by a little later and help sort through it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Dane. I’ll set things out and make a quick list so we can see what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m listening—what details do you already have for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve heard we’re collecting tools and spare parts for the repair drive, and a few folks are coordinating drop-off times. I’m still running errands, so I’ll check back with the latest details soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—I’ll wait for the latest drop-off details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive — right, I heard about that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking which houses still need a pickup, so I just need your location and whether you’ve set anything out yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m at 14 Maple, and I haven’t put anything out yet. Sorry, I almost missed that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. I’ve got a simple plan ready — we just need to sort the donations, then we can head over together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I can help sort the donations. Just point me to the pile and I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great—happy to help connect folks if you want me to spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Jules — can you confirm what day and time the repair drive is?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I just need to check the details so I can give you the right day and time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Tess — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful — thank you! I could use help spreading the word and maybe sorting donations when they come in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can spread the word and help sort donations when they come in. Just let me know what time and where to start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand and bring over whatever tools we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you let me know which tools you’re bringing so I can make sure we don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring a hammer, a cordless drill, a tape measure, and a set of screwdrivers. If you think of anything else, just let me know before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where things are for the repair drive—just tell me what needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect—thanks, Opal! I’ll send people your way as soon as I hear what needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, just point them to me and I’ll keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—just tell me when the repair drive is happening and what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Faye — I’m still pinning down the exact time, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set and what tools we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just keep me posted, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice turnout today — folks are really pitching in. I can swing by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Tess. I appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll stop by after lunch and check if they need hands, tools, or snacks. If you hear anything, just send it my way!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect — I’ve been meaning to get folks together for that. I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I really appreciate you helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll let everyone on the block know and encourage them to stop by. This is going to be a great turnout!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — what’s the first repair you want me to look at?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, start with the squeaky porch door if you don’t mind — I keep meaning to oil it and then I forget.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll take a look at the porch door first. Do you want it just oiled, or should I check the hinges too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help a little with the repair drive—what do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s so kind of you, Rey — thank you. We need help sorting donations and checking which homes need the most urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. Tell me where to start, and I’ll help sort the donations first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and let folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and pass them along if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block and make sure everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting set up soon—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure on the exact list, but they usually still need tools, gloves, and a few volunteers. I’ll skim for the sign-up and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d appreciate that. If you spot the sign-up, could you tell me what they’re asking for?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Sam — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and warm, so let’s make it easy for everyone to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Rosa — I can help keep things simple and welcoming for folks who stop by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — let’s greet everyone at the door and keep the sign-up sheet easy to find.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can chip in a little, but I’ll need to keep it quiet right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. How much can you contribute, and when could you quietly send it over?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can send 20 tonight, after everyone’s settled in. I’d appreciate it staying between us for now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in, and I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh great, thanks Mara — that really helps. I’ll keep an eye out for more folks who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll start asking around and see who can lend a hand.
